formulas.ascii: Track length L=sum of step distances d[i]; average speed=L/T for positive track duration T, otherwise 0. Steps stay within track offsets; distances are Euclidean or great-circle in context units. Time differences are computed before f32 conversion (Int64 or double-single where supplied). Stop extraction is a separate slow-run scan and compaction.
